note: The ringed giant from the port's sky, made real: a gas_ball, a real ball of gas 3.5 km in radius (its type's surface) that you fly round. Fly within its handoff of the cloud tops and its scene takes over with no fade, like Grit Station; go down into the clouds and the ship is lost. Issue #576: it orbits the sun ('near': 'sun', 'at' from the sun's centre), 57 km out to the home planet's 40, and still hangs where the sky painting was from the port (azimuth 26, elevation 17), 85 km from home's centre so the open-space leg is about 60 s at cruise. From the port it looks about 5 degrees wide, smaller than the painting. replaces_sky_painting turns the painted giant off wherever this real one is drawn and on the planet itself. body: its look from space and its own sky (banded like the painting, with its ring; inner and outer in planet radii). Its town is the space station (content/core/stations/orbital_station.json, PR #501) over the top of the ball: station_town names its landmark, and StationHull.town_for makes the town only the station's bay, so a save loaded here puts you in the bay, a crashed ship is towed to the dock pad and falling out puts you back in the bay. No deck. Its cantina is the station's own, on the top floor, with a new Oda behind the bar (orbital_station.json 'cantina'). Z docks you in the bay.
air_note: The air is breathable: no armour needed outside the station (harmful_surface {} keeps it that way whatever the type says). So the station is open to it: you can walk out of the bay's mouth past the shield and roam outside on the jetpack; drop too far toward the clouds and you are pulled back into the station (SpaceStation.open_air).

landmarks.note: The station (moved here from the moon, PR #501) over the top of the giant, 200 m above the ball's radius (the clouds are 120 m under that): the market floor and the bay's deck are 200 m up. Inside the giant's own scene (its handoff reaches 2600 m above the clouds).

Issue #838: the three Remnant skimmer outposts (content/core/stations/skimmer_outpost.json), just over the horizon from the station city: 52 degrees round the ball from it (3176 m along the ball's radius on the map; the cloud tops, 120 m under the radius, hide anything at 200 m past 48 degrees from the station's deck, and the outpost's mast top from its top floor past 51.2), 120 degrees apart round it (86 degrees, about 5 km, between any two), all at its 200 m. 'level' 'ball': stood level with the ball's own up where it hangs, not the port's (StationHull.frame_for); its bay's mouth faces the station city.

Issue #327: a second Remnant star cruiser (content/core/cruiser/belt_cruiser.json, the home one's ship), holding station about 4.2 km out from the station toward the bay's mouth (west): 'at' is 2.8 km west along the ball from under the station, 'altitude' metres over the ball's radius, past this sky's edge of space (2000 m) and under the end of the giant's own scene (2600 m over the clouds, about 2480 over the radius), so the flight there, its escort fight and its bay are all this scene. There it rides about 5 degrees over the station's deck line, framed in the bay's mouth and over the floors' parapets; any further out round the ball it sinks below the deck and the bay's own floor hides it. Level with the station, its bay turned toward it; yaw_deg turns it about its up.
